blocks.text: Product Description               This back support cushion for office chair is designed to provide ergonomic support, helping you maintain comfort throughout the day. Ideal as a back support cushion for chair use at work, this memory foam back support cushion features a cooling gel layer that enhances your seating experience. Its portable design allows you to use it as airplane back support cushion or move it between different chairs, including as a computer chair cushion or for a dorm desk chair. Offering pressure relief wherever needed, it's also a great gel back support cushion for pressure relief and a pressure relief back support cushion option. As a chair pillow back support cushions alternative, it helps to alleviate discomfort and provide ultimate support                  From the Manufacturer               Amazon Basics

items.label: ERGONOMIC COMFORT
items.value: This ergonomic desk chair cushion is designed to enhance your seating experience on any office chair for maximum relief

items.label: OPTIMAL SUPPORT
items.value: This back support cushion is ideal for long sitting periods, featuring firm memory foam that aligns with your body's natural contours

items.label: CONTOURED DESIGN
items.value: Benefit from a memory foam back support cushion that conforms to your body's natural curvature, providing personalized comfort

items.label: SECURE PLACEMENT
items.value: Avoid slipping with a non-skid base that helps your cushion stay securely in place, enhancing comfort for prolonged sitting sessions

items.label: PORTABLE CONVENIENCE
items.value: Easily transfer your desk back support cushion between chairs with its lightweight, movable design, offering comfort wherever you sit, from home to office or while traveling
